title: Dimension Is Free, Horizon Is Not: When Evolution Strategies Rival Policy Gradients for LLM Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2611.29795v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Policy gradient (PG) methods such as GRPO dominate LLM fine-tuning, yet recent work showed that Evolution Strategies (ES) also scale to fine-tuning models with billions of parameters. Which method needs fewer samples, and on which tasks, remains unclear. We view the two methods as estimators of the same gradient that differ in where they explore. Because ES perturbs parameters, its noise grows with the number of parameters, and because PG samples actions, its noise grows with the number of generated tokens. Only noise along the directions that change the reward slows learning. The cost of ES then depends on the effective dimension, the number of independent skills a task requires rather than its parameter count, while the cost of PG depends on the effective horizon, which counts only the tokens that share both credit and weights with the reward-carrying ones. translated_title: 维度是免费的，视野不是：进化策略何时能在LLM微调中与策略梯度相媲美
translated_abstract: 策略梯度（PG）方法（如GRPO）在LLM微调中占据主导地位，但近期研究表明，进化策略（ES）也能扩展到拥有数十亿参数模型的微调。然而，哪种方法需要更少的样本、在哪些任务上更优，目前仍不清楚。我们将这两种方法视为对同一梯度的估计器，它们的区别在于探索的位置。由于ES扰动的是参数，其噪声随参数数量增长；而PG采样的是动作，其噪声随生成token数量增长。只有沿着改变奖励方向的噪声才会减缓学习。因此，ES的成本取决于有效维度——即任务所需的独立技能数量，而非参数总量；PG的成本则取决于有效视野——即仅统计那些与承载奖励的token共享信用和权重的token数量。我们在一个合成任务上对这两种方法进行训练，该任务中技能数量与有效……
tldr: 进化策略（ES）的样本成本取决于任务的有效维度（即所需独立技能数）而非参数量，而策略梯度（PG）的成本取决于有效视野，这为两种方法在LLM微调中的适用场景提供了理论依据。
en_tdlr: The sample cost of Evolution Strategies depends on a task's effective dimension (number of independent skills) rather than parameter count, while Policy Gradients' cost depends on the effective horizon, providing a theoretical basis for when each method is preferable in LLM fine-tuning.
